claim_text: 來源機構：ACM Transactions on Computing Education (ACM)；資料標題：Interaction Patterns and Embodied Design Processes Using an AI Robotics Kit for K–12 Education；來源刊登日：2026-10-15。作者摘要報告：研究探討兒童如何與一款透過動手製作教授機器學習（ML）概念的低成本教育機器人工具互動；研究者帶領三次介入，參與兒童年齡為 10、11 與 13 歲，各自以該套件打造一台 AI 強化的機器人，並以質性分析與流程探勘方法分析介入中的互動。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Interaction Patterns and Embodied Design Processes Using an AI Robotics Kit for K–12 Education
title_zh: 運用 K–12 教育 AI 機器人套件的互動模式與具身設計歷程
source_locator: ACM Digital Library 文章頁（管理者 2026-10-16 截圖）：Just Accepted；Accepted on 17 September 2026；Online AM: 15 October 2026；出版者 PDF（Just Accepted 版，管理者提供）：ACM 1946-6226/2026/10-ART；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 1、3、4 句（出版者網頁對自動請求回 403）
original_excerpt: This multidisciplinary study explores how children interact with a low-cost robotics educational tool designed to teach machine learning (ML) concepts through hands-on making. … We conducted three researcher-led interventions with children aged 10, 11 and 13, each tasked to build an AI-enhanced robot using the robotics kit. … Interventions were analyzed both qualitatively and with process mining methods to gain an in-depth view of the interactions.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、設計與分析方法；介入研究，依規則不寫結果。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（ACM Transactions on Computing Education，監測清單 J14），Just Accepted 版；小規模質性研究，三次介入各 1 名兒童（共 3 人，內文 2.3 節），經監護人招募，非學校情境；本則不涉及結果。

ai_lit_note: 兒童以機器人套件動手學機器學習概念、打造 AI 機器人，對應 S-BAS「理解AI運作原理與限制」
summary_evidence_spans: This multidisciplinary study explores how children interact with a low-cost robotics educational tool designed to teach machine learning (ML) concepts through hands-on making.
We conducted three researcher-led interventions with children aged 10, 11 and 13, each tasked to build an AI-enhanced robot using the robotics kit.
Interventions were analyzed both qualitatively and with process mining methods to gain an in-depth view of the interactions.

claim_text: 來源機構：Discover Education (Springer Nature)；資料標題：Development and validation of an artificial intelligence literacy scale for students；來源刊登日：2026-10-15。作者摘要報告：研究旨在檢視 AI 素養概念，發展有效且可信的學生 AI 素養量表；樣本為就讀國小與國中 4 至 8 年級的 870 名學生，研究者先編製 50 題題庫，作者報告探索性因素分析得到 22 題、6 個分量表，驗證性因素分析的測量模型適配良好。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Development and validation of an artificial intelligence literacy scale for students
title_zh: 學生人工智慧素養量表之發展與驗證
source_locator: Springer Nature Link 文章頁（管理者 2026-10-16 截圖）：Published: 15 October 2026；Volume 5, article number 1176 (2026)；出版者 PDF（管理者提供）：Received 19 March 2026 / Accepted 13 August 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 3–7 句（出版者網頁對自動請求回 JavaScript 攔截頁）
original_excerpt: In this context, the aim of this study is to develop a valid and reliable scale to obtain accurate data on artificial intelligence literacy by examining the concept of artificial intelligence literacy. … The study sample consists of 870 students (424 boys, 346 girls) in grades 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 attending elementary and middle schools. … A pool of 50 items was created to measure students’ levels of artificial intelligence literacy. … Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) resulted in 22 items and 6 subscales. … The measurement model obtained from Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) demonstrated good fit.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、樣本、題庫與作者所述因素結構；量表發展研究，非介入研究。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Discover Education，監測清單 J32）；量表發展研究，樣本來自土耳其 Niğde 省（內文），研究限制段稱便利抽樣、參與者段寫立意抽樣，原文前後不一；摘要性別人數 424＋346 與總數 870 不符，內文寫女生 446 人（51.3%）但表 1 仍列 346，本則只寫總數。

ai_lit_note: 發展國中小學生 AI 素養量表（AI 素養量表依準則判 A）；分量表含 AI 使用技能與取用、學習歷程中的 AI 等，對應 S-BAS「管理AI工具於多元情境之應用」與 S-LRN「理解AI輔助學習的角色功能」
summary_evidence_spans: In this context, the aim of this study is to develop a valid and reliable scale to obtain accurate data on artificial intelligence literacy by examining the concept of artificial intelligence literacy.
The study sample consists of 870 students (424 boys, 346 girls) in grades 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 attending elementary and middle schools.
A pool of 50 items was created to measure students’ levels of artificial intelligence literacy.
Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) resulted in 22 items and 6 subscales.
The measurement model obtained from Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) demonstrated good fit.
attributed_summary: 研究旨在檢視 AI 素養概念，發展有效且可信的學生 AI 素養量表；樣本為就讀國小與國中 4 至 8 年級的 870 名學生，研究者先編製 50 題題庫，作者報告探索性因素分析得到 22 題、6 個分量表，驗證性因素分析的測量模型適配良好。
